name: Bonus Withdrawal 2
definition: Information about a bonus paid out or a withdrawal.

TypeOfAmount.name: Type Of Amount
TypeOfAmount.definition: Specifies whether the amount is the result of a bonus paid, a withdrawal or other kind of amount.

Amount.name: Amount
Amount.definition: Amount of the bonus paid or the claimed amount. For example, a claimed amount for a lifetime ISA (LISA) or a government bonus paid out.

Reason.name: Reason
Reason.definition: Reason for the bonus amount paid to or an amount withdrawn from the investment product.

UnclaimedAmount.name: Unclaimed Amount
UnclaimedAmount.definition: Amount of an unclaimed bonus or an unclaimed withdrawal.

Outstanding.name: Outstanding
Outstanding.definition: Indicates whether there is an outstanding bonus or withdrawal amount.

Reference.name: Reference
Reference.definition: Identification of the withdrawal or bonus.

AdditionalInformation.name: Additional Information
AdditionalInformation.definition: Additional information about the monies paid out or withdrawn.
